title: Check Palindrome
description: Given a string `s`, determine whether it is a palindrome (ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters). Print `Palindrome` if true, otherwise `Not Palindrome`.
instructions: Keep only alphanumeric characters and convert to lowercase.
Check if the cleaned string reads the same forward and backward.

examples.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

hints: Filter characters using `isalnum()` in Python, `/[^a-z0-9]/g` in JS, or `Character.isLetterOrDigit()` in Java.
Use two pointers `left = 0`, `right = len - 1` moving inward.
If any pair differs, print `Not Palindrome`.

starterCode.python:
s = input().strip()
# Print Palindrome or Not Palindrome

publicTestCases.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
